pretreatments.description: Organosolv pretreatment with sodium hydroxide as a catalyst, using 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing 1% (w/w) NaOH as a catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH 7.0.

Organosolv pretreatment with sulfuric acid as a catalyst, using 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol containing 1% (w/w) H_2SO_4 as a catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH 7.0.

Hydrothermal pretreatment with sulfuric acid as a catalyst, using distilled water and 1% (w/w) H_2SO_4 as the catalyst, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with distilled water until pH 7.0.
Auto-catalyzed organosolv pretreatment with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol and distilled water until pH 7.0.
Auto-catalyzed hydrothermal pretreatment with distilled water, heated at 190 °C for 60 min, followed by washing with distilled water until pH 7.0.
